cohort: The study included 1,912,204 children born in Sweden between 1991 and 2009, 6,596 of whom developed celiac disease before 15 years of age.
finding: Elective caesarean delivery and repeated maternal urinary tract infections during pregnancy are associated with an increased risk of celiac disease onset during childhood, while high maternal age and high income reduced the risk.
mod_finding: Among boys, elective caesarean delivery increased the risk of celiac disease (OR 1.2; 95% CI 1.0-1.4).
birth_weight: low birth weight was measured and showed a negative association with CD risk.
